answer.notes: Column indices are zero-based; all other columns are exactly unchanged. The dominant singular values are 0.55276009 and 0.00102474, a gap of approximately 539, supporting rank one. Joint nonlinear least-squares fitting gives c = 5.999758397949588, consistent with an underlying scale of 6. Using c = 6 gives residual RMS 4.62474e-05 and relative Frobenius residual 0.00757239, consistent with combined input/output bfloat16 rounding (estimated RMS 4.84032e-05). The recovered unit direction is saved to /workspace/task/out/r_hat.npy as a float64 array of shape (256,), with norm 1. Its sign is arbitrary; the largest-magnitude component was made positive.
